## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

##### Featured Program

### **Announcing 2026 In-Person Events**

**Your learning and relationships should grow all year long — and now, they will!**

Starting in 2026, ACD Regional Meetings will follow a new seasonal schedule, with meetings held in
the Winter, Spring, and Fall, rotating to different cities each year to make participation more
accessible for members nationwide. Alongside these enhanced Regionals, we are also excited to share
the confirmed dates and locations for ChemEdge, the Washington Fly-In, and the 2026 Annual Meeting.

Whether you are building new connections, strengthening your team’s capabilities, or tackling
industry challenges together, ACD events bring our community closer, wherever you are.

**More details on each event will be available soon. We look forward to seeing you there.**

##### [On Our Radar: The Connection between MAHA and the Broader Regulatory Landscape][59]

ACD Responsible Distribution™ is built on continuous improvement. For decades, ACD members have not
only met compliance standards, but they’ve gone above and beyond what is required. This is integral
to our core identity and makes us true leaders in the chemical distribution sector.

[New and Improved: ACD's 2026 Membership & Safety Questionnaire Arrives This Week in Inboxes]
June 3, 2026

##### [New and Improved: ACD's 2026 Membership & Safety Questionnaire Arrives This Week in
##### Inboxes][60]

Our members drive what we do here at ACD, and we are most effective in our joint advocacy work when
we have the resources, information, and background on the members we serve and the challenges they
face. Many might remember ACD’s annual membership survey. Up until a few years ago, we regularly
asked our members to share data on their work, the size of their business, and the logistics
involved in safely delivering the chemical products essential to everyday life.

About Us

## The most delicate on the market.

Our Anprolene sterilizers have the most delicate 100% EO sterilization cycle on the market. Room
temperature sterilization, no steam injection, no deep vacuum, and uses only 17.6 g of gas – all in
a convenient tabletop cabinet.

Anprolene sterilizers now features a number of important improvements. They include: more powerful
ventilation and purge pumps, unique active aeration system, digital display tracks cycle progress,
temperature sensor monitors room conditions during each cycle, microprocessor monitors cycle and
automatically restores system in case of power failure.

## Industries we serve

We provide specialist sterilization knowledge, products and services to a wide range of industries
including:
* Agriculture
* Cleanrooms
* Cosmetics & Toiletries
* Dentists
* Environmental Research
* Food & Beverage
* Government Agencies
* Hospitals
* Laborotories
* Medical Device Manufacturers
* Packaging
* Plastic Surgery
* Tattoo / Piercing
* Universities
* Vets

## Unmatched Sterilisation Compatibility

Anprolene’s 100% EO system sterilizes at room temperature without external vacuum lines or steam
generator. Protects your most delicate instruments, electronics, drills, fiber optics, cameras and
plastic or rubber items.

[Contact Us][37]

## Why choose Bioceb

### Choose Bioceb!

Bioceb is a 2-year joint master's programme, offering a state-of-the-art and innovative curriculum,
training future research and innovation (…)

### Employability & career prospects

Bioceb offers a highly professional and personalised training, closely connected to socio-economic
stakeholders, enabling graduates to pursue international careers across academia, research, and
industry, with a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and climate change mitigation. Building professional
skills Bioceb allows students to personalise their profile and access professions focused on the
production of plants and micro-organisms, on the design and development of products or processes (…)

trips, webinars, and collaborative events throughout the programme.

[Novel Salicylaldehyde Schiff Base Derivatives: Synthesis, Structural Elucidation and

**Abstract ** In this study, a novel salicylaldehyde-based Schiff base derivative was synthesized
through a condensation reaction between salicylaldehyde and an aromatic amine. The synthesized
compound was characterized by FT-IR, UV–Visible, ¹H NMR, ¹³C NMR, and ESI-MS techniques, confirming

against MCF-7 cells. The obtained findings suggest that salicylaldehyde-derived Schiff bases may
serve as promising candidates for the development of new anticancer agents.

Pages 111-126

[https://doi.org/10.22034/bmc.2026.582939.1104][43]

Shayan Mahmoodi, Arman Nazari

[Synthesis, Characterization and Wound-Healing Potential of Chitosan–Silver Nanocomposites ]

**Abstract ** Chitosan–silver nanocomposites were successfully synthesized and evaluated as
potential wound-healing materials. The prepared nanocomposites were characterized by FT-IR, XRD,
SEM, TEM, EDX, TGA, and DSC analyses. The results confirmed the successful incorporation of silver
nanoparticles into the chitosan matrix and revealed enhanced thermal stability and favorable
physicochemical properties. The nanocomposite exhibited excellent swelling behavior, suitable water
vapor transmission, and significant antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and
Escherichia coli. In addition, cytocompatibility and scratch assay results demonstrated improved
cell viability and accelerated wound closure. These findings indicate that chitosan–silver
nanocomposites are promising candidates for advanced wound-dressing applications.

the most ambitious HSE standards. [Read more][57] Logistics And Packaging One of the key roles of
the European chemical distribution sector is to bring flexibility to clients when it comes to
volumes and packaging. We ensure that our clients can get what they need, in whatever quantity they
need, and whenever they need it. [Read more][58]

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]

[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.
[ Get The Details ][112]
[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate

across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official

## Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)

**Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)** is an advanced in-vitro assay used to detect pyrogens in
pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and biologics. Pyrogens—substances that can induce
fever—pose a serious risk to patient safety. MAT offers a reliable, ethical, and human-relevant
alternative to traditional animal-based tests such as the Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT).

## Introducing

## Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)

**Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)** is an advanced in-vitro assay used to detect pyrogens in
pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and biologics. Pyrogens—substances that can induce
fever—pose a serious risk to patient safety. MAT offers a reliable, ethical, and human-relevant
alternative to traditional animal-based tests such as the Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT).

### Measuring the Self-Reported Impact of Early-2026 AI on Technical Worker Productivity

A survey of 349 technical workers finds a median 1.4–2x self-reported change in value of work due to
AI tools, expected to grow over time, though there are reasons to be skeptical of the magnitude.

[Read more ][30]
[Early Work on Monitorability Evaluations]

### Early Work on Monitorability Evaluations

We show preliminary results on a prototype evaluation that tests monitors' ability to catch AI
agents doing side tasks, and AI agents' ability to bypass this monitoring.

[Read more ][31]

### How Does Time Horizon Vary Across Domains?

We build on our time-horizon work and analyze 9 benchmarks for scientific reasoning, math, robotics,
computer use, and self-driving in terms of time-horizon trends; we observe generally similar rates
of improvement to the 7-month doubling time in our original time-horizon work.

## Featured Research

Our AI evaluations research focuses on assessing broad autonomous capabilities and the ability of AI
systems to accelerate AI R&D. We also study potential AI behavior that threatens the integrity of
evaluations and mitigations for such behavior.

[View all research ][25]

[Measuring the Self-Reported Impact of Early-2026 AI on Technical Worker Productivity]

### Measuring the Self-Reported Impact of Early-2026 AI on Technical Worker Productivity

A survey of 349 technical workers finds a median 1.4–2x self-reported change in value of work due to
AI tools, expected to grow over time, though there are reasons to be skeptical of the magnitude.

[Read more ][30]
[Early Work on Monitorability Evaluations]

### Early Work on Monitorability Evaluations

We show preliminary results on a prototype evaluation that tests monitors' ability to catch AI
agents doing side tasks, and AI agents' ability to bypass this monitoring.

[Read more ][31]
[How Does Time Horizon Vary Across Domains?]

### How Does Time Horizon Vary Across Domains?

We build on our time-horizon work and analyze 9 benchmarks for scientific reasoning, math, robotics,
computer use, and self-driving in terms of time-horizon trends; we observe generally similar rates
of improvement to the 7-month doubling time in our original time-horizon work.

[Read more ][32]

### Measuring autonomous AI capabilities — resource collection

[Read more ][35]

### Common Elements of Frontier AI Safety Policies

An analysis of the shared components across twelve published frontier AI safety policies, including
capability thresholds, model weight security, and deployment mitigations

### Frontier AI Safety Policies

We describe areas for risk transparency and specific technical questions that a frontier AI
developer could answer.

chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Forschung Du tätig bist; ob im produzierenden Gewerbe oder im
Bereich der Analytik/Diagnostik – wir haben das passende Produkt für Dich! Besuche gerne unseren
[Onlineshop][107] oder wirf einen Blick in unser [umfassendes Sortiment][108].

## [Was zeichnet uns aus?][109]

Dank der Kompetenz und [langjährigen Erfahrung][110] des gesamten [neoFroxx-Teams][111], unserer
Kooperation mit hervorragenden Partnerfirmen und eines [weltweiten Distributorennetzwerks][112] ist
es uns innerhalb weniger Jahre gelungen, unsere [Marken][113] bei Händler*innen und Endnutzer*innen
erfolgreich zu etablieren. Dabei profitieren wir nicht nur von unserem erstklassigen
Qualitätsmanagement (gemäß ISO 9001:2015).

Ein ganz entscheidender Faktor für unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg ist unser hohes Maß an Flexibilität,
welches es uns ermöglicht, individuell auf Kundenwünsche einzugehen.

## [Was machen wir genau?][114]

Spezialisiert ist neoFroxx auf den Vertrieb und die Herstellung von Labor- und Biochemikalien. Wir
beliefern schwerpunktmäßig Universitäten mit den Fachrichtungen Biochemie, Molekularbiologie,
Mikrobiologie und Zellbiologie (die sogenannten Life Sciences), sowie Forscher*innen im Bereich der
organischen, anorganischen und pharmazeutischen Chemie. Zu unseren Kund*innen gehören aber auch
Herstellerfirmen von Diagnostika und Zellkulturprodukten, chemische Industrie, Prüflabore (z.B.
Wasser- und Lebensmittelanalytik), Qualitätskontrollen und viele mehr.

Neben Chemikalien aus eigener Herstellung steht uns für Deutschland exklusiv das Produktportfolio
eines der weltweit größten Produzenten für mikrobiologische Medien, [HiMedia Laboratories][115], zur
Verfügung. Verstärkung für den Forschungs-, Diagnostik- und Produktionsbereich rund um die
Zellkultur erhalten wir von [Biological Industries][116]. Unser Chemikaliensortiment wird durch
Fein- und Spezialchemikalien von [PENTA][117] abgerundet.

## [Wo arbeiten wir?][118]

Unser Firmensitz befindet sich seit 2015 in dem kleinen Ort Einhausen, verkehrsgünstig gelegen an
den Autobahnen A67 und A5 und in unmittelbarer Nähe zu den Metropolregionen und Universitätsstädten
Frankfurt (Main), Darmstadt, Mainz, Mannheim und Heidelberg. Hier – mit Blick auf die schöne
Bergstraße – wird auch unsere Eigenmarke [neoFroxx][119] produziert.

## EO Chex™ is Now Available!

Propper Manufacturing Company is excited to announce that EO Chex™ Ethylene Oxide (EO) Indicator
Tape has achieved FDA clearance, solidifying its position as the only FDA-cleared EO indicator tape
on the market.

[Order Now][63]

## Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilization

Ethylene oxide (EO) sterilization is a versatile method used in various industries, particularly
medical device manufacturing. Propper Manufacturing provides key monitoring tools to ensure
compliance and optimize EO sterilization processes.

[Learn More][64]

## Our Digital Catalog

Whether you're a hospital, laboratory, veterinarian, or dental office, we understand your unique
requirements. Leverage our decades of experience to access the tools you can rely on. Discover the
comprehensive range of medical device solutions in our catalog today.

[Learn More][65]

### Propper Manufacturing Company Announces FDA Clearance of New EO Chex™ Ethylene Oxide Indicator
### Tape

“Propper has stepped up to fill a critical gap in the market, proudly introducing EO Chex™ as the
only FDA-cleared ethylene oxide indicator tape available in the United States.” – Joe Looney,
President & CEO, Medical

[Read The Full Press Release][66]

**Products**

## Shop Propper Products Today

### The Propper Advantage

Our flagship product, the [Vapor Line® Integrator][67], is a chemical indicator that seamlessly
monitors all critical parameters in steam sterilization processes. It provides an easy-to-read
“PASS” or “FAIL” indicator, giving you peace of mind that your instruments and equipment are sterile
and safe.

Beyond single-use indicators, we also offer innovative solutions like the [Vapor Line® Reusable
Sterilization Process Challenge Test][68]. This Helix-Type PCD can be reused multiple times,
monitoring multiple loads with our Vapor Line® Steam Sterilization Integrator. It’s a cost-effective
and eco-friendly option for high-volume sterilization cycles.

[VIEW PRODUCTS][69]

### Original Equipment Manufacturer

Propper’s innovative OEM solutions are trusted by some of the largest brands in the healthcare
industry. Our experienced teams collaborate with you to create products that are cost-effective,
environmentally friendly, and ISO & FDA compliant.

### Decoding biology to radically improve lives

Recursion was founded more than a decade ago on the idea that we could take images of cells and use
these images to train artificial intelligence to understand the vast unknown biological space – the
cellular disruptions driving disease – to use AI-drug discovery to reduce the massive 90% failure
rate of traditional drug discovery.

### Better medicines, through novel insights and precision design

We’re using data and AI to bring better medicines to patients, faster.

The Recursion OS drug discovery and development platform has yielded an advanced pipeline of
potential first-in-class and best-in-class treatments for conditions with high unmet need including
aggressive cancers and rare diseases. Today, we’ve demonstrated significant improvements in speed,
efficiency, and reduced costs from hit identification to IND-enabling studies compared to
traditional pharmaceutical company averages.

### Delivering for our partners

Our strategic partnerships allow us to accelerate the discovery of new medicines and expand our
potential impact on patients via AI-drug discovery.

This includes pharmaceutical partnerships with industry leaders, technology partnerships with
computational titans, and next-generation data partnerships that enhance our capabilities and
generative AI for pharma as one of the top AI drug discovery companies in the industry.

[Partner with Recursion][30]

### 3 key ingredients: data, models, and compute

Over the last decade, we have generated and aggregated one of the largest fit-for-purpose
proprietary biological and chemical datasets in the world — >50 petabytes spanning phenomics,
transcriptomics, proteomics, ADME, and de-identified patient data. Our automated wet lab utilizes
robotics and computer vision to capture millions of cell experiments per week — enabling us to
quickly make and test novel discoveries. All of our results feed back into our drug discovery and
drug development platform – the Recursion Operating System – in a continuously improving feedback
loop.

Our data and the Recursion OS enable us to train intelligent machine learning models for AI drug
discovery and development, which help us rapidly identify new targets and design highly optimized
molecules that fuel our pipeline of potential first-in-class and best-in-class medicines.

To process all this data, we worked with NVIDIA to build biopharma’s most powerful supercomputer:
BioHive-2.

### Decoding biology to radically improve lives

Recursion was founded more than a decade ago on the idea that we could take images of cells and use
these images to train artificial intelligence to understand the vast unknown biological space – the
cellular disruptions driving disease – to use AI-drug discovery to reduce the massive 90% failure
rate of traditional drug discovery.

### Better medicines, through novel insights and precision design

We’re using data and AI to bring better medicines to patients, faster.

The Recursion OS drug discovery and development platform has yielded an advanced pipeline of
potential first-in-class and best-in-class treatments for conditions with high unmet need including
aggressive cancers and rare diseases. Today, we’ve demonstrated significant improvements in speed,
efficiency, and reduced costs from hit identification to IND-enabling studies compared to
traditional pharmaceutical company averages.

### Delivering for our partners

Our strategic partnerships allow us to accelerate the discovery of new medicines and expand our
potential impact on patients via AI-drug discovery.

This includes pharmaceutical partnerships with industry leaders, technology partnerships with
computational titans, and next-generation data partnerships that enhance our capabilities and
generative AI for pharma as one of the top AI drug discovery companies in the industry.

[Partner with Recursion][30]

### 3 key ingredients: data, models, and compute

Over the last decade, we have generated and aggregated one of the largest fit-for-purpose
proprietary biological and chemical datasets in the world — >50 petabytes spanning phenomics,
transcriptomics, proteomics, ADME, and de-identified patient data. Our automated wet lab utilizes
robotics and computer vision to capture millions of cell experiments per week — enabling us to
quickly make and test novel discoveries. All of our results feed back into our drug discovery and
drug development platform – the Recursion Operating System – in a continuously improving feedback
loop.

Our data and the Recursion OS enable us to train intelligent machine learning models for AI drug
discovery and development, which help us rapidly identify new targets and design highly optimized
molecules that fuel our pipeline of potential first-in-class and best-in-class medicines.

To process all this data, we worked with NVIDIA to build biopharma’s most powerful supercomputer:
BioHive-2.

# SQAS

Safety & Quality Assessment for Sustainability

An assessment scheme for chemical companies to evaluate the safety, environmental, security and
quality performance of logistics service providers and distributors.

## SQAS benefits

Chemical Companies

Help improve safety, quality, sustainability, and operational excellence across your chemical supply
chain

[Read more ][32]

Logistics Service Providers and Distributors

Drive SQAS while boosting your company's visibility and network in the chemical supply chain

[Read more ][33]

Assessors

Contribute to safety standards, evaluate practices, and enhance the quality of chemical logistics

[Read more ][34]

Federations

Help promote excellence in the industry and collaborate with assessors for best practices

[Read more ][35]

# System Informer

A **free**, powerful, multi-purpose tool that helps you **monitor system resources**, **debug
software** and **detect malware**.

[ Download System Informer][14]
[screenshot]

#### Graphs and statistics allow you quickly to track down resource hogs and runaway processes.

Use Ctrl+I to view system performance information. Move your cursor over a graph to get a tooltip
with information about the data point under your cursor. You can double-click the graph to see
information about the process at that data point, even if the process is no longer running.

[screenshot]

#### Can't edit or delete a file? Discover which processes are using that file.

Use Ctrl+F to search for a handle or DLL. If all else fails, you can right-click an entry and close
the handle associated with the file. However, this should only be used as a last resort and can lead
to data loss and corruption.

[screenshot]

#### See what programs have active network connections, and close them if necessary.

Use Ctrl+I to view system performance information. Move your cursor over a graph to get a tooltip
with information about the data point under your cursor. You can double-click the graph to see
information about the process at that data point, even if the process is no longer running.

[screenshot]

#### See a hightly detailed overview of system activity with highlighting.

Add extra columns to show even more system activity and information!

[screenshot]

#### Get real-time information on disk access.

This may look very similar to the Disk Activity feature in Resource Monitor, but System Informer has
a few more features!

[screenshot]

#### Get real-time information on disk usage.

Enable disk statistics for detailed disk usage information.

[screenshot]

#### View detailed stack traces with kernel-mode, WOW64 and .NET support.

Hover your cursor over the first column (with the numbers) to view parameter and line number
information when available.

[screenshot]

#### Get real-time information on network usage.

Enable network adapter statistics for detailed information network usage information.

[screenshot]

#### Go beyond services.msc: create, edit and control services.

By default, System Informer shows entries for drivers in addition to normal user-mode services. You
can turn this off by checking **View > Hide Driver Services**.

[screenshot]

#### Get real-time information on gpu usage.

By default, System Informer shows gpu usage for all processes. Hover your cursor over the graph for
detailed information when available.

[screenshot]

#### Theme support to match your style.

System Informer supports light and dark themes and has options for modern icons.

[screenshot]

история создания, достижения, цифры
**В конце июня 2025 года** был дан «Старт» новому направлению в переработке **– запущен в
эксплуатацию Завод технических фабрикатов.** Это завод по переработке боенских отходов. На сегодня
произведены пуско-наладочные работы, произведена работа по отладке технологических процессов нового
производства.
Созданные производственные номинальные мощности ЗТФ:
**Цель создания ЗТФ** – обеспечение биобезопасности производств АПХ, самостоятельная переработка
боенских отходов, образующихся на предприятиях АПХ "Дороничи".
